---
applyTo: "backend/**/*,*.py"
---

- All api routes naming should be proper convention and all should start with route "/api"
- Handle error handling in backend, not propogate to frontend
- database connection string handle in secure way
- Ensure all APIs are explained in the documentation.
- Verify changes in the backend are reflected in the frontend (`src/static/**`). If possible breaking changes are found, mention them to the developer.
